The ticket repair is saved, and the re-extracted acceptance criterion now reads: "The report-view setting uses the shared settings resolver." The spec carries it `in-scope`, because it matches the resolver-to-view path we traced (`settings/resolver.ts:12` → `ui/report-view.ts:30`). The framing stays as kept. I'm recording the repaired criterion in the draft under `## Appended during questionary`.

When a user switches workspaces, what should the new report-view setting control for the active filters?
A) No choice for users: filters always reset to defaults on a workspace switch, and the setting only holds the reset default in the resolver.
B) A user-facing toggle, "reset filters on workspace switch," defaulting to on in the resolver so rows are no longer hidden. Users who want filters carried over can turn it off.
C) A per-workspace filter memory: each workspace restores its own last filters, and the setting turns that memory on or off.
D) other - name it
Recommendation: B - the resolver already owns defaults, so a default-on toggle fixes the hidden-rows symptom through the one settings path without discarding the current carry-over behavior.

What should happen to report filters when the user switches workspaces?
A) Clear active filters so the destination workspace starts unfiltered.
B) Restore the destination workspace’s previously used filters.
C) Preserve the current filters across workspaces, but make that behavior configurable.
D) Other - name the desired behavior.
Recommendation: A - it directly prevents filters from the previous workspace from hiding rows in the destination.
